versions.changelog:
Initial release of Boring Social Publisher.

- Publish content to multiple social media platforms (Facebook, Instagram, Threads, YouTube, TikTok, X) with one message.
- No API keys or local credential setup required—use a secure MCP connector link.
- Handles content adaptation for each platform's requirements (text limits, media formatting).
- Supports immediate publishing or scheduled posts across accounts.
- Includes robust error handling and clear post-publication reporting.
